scope: model_selection._Resident and _arena_io DeviceCache/resident constructor/reinitialization, release, close, context exit, resident scope and take
reason: The lifecycle no longer inspects owner graphs, so the Arrow owner-inspection gap no longer matters. Every native free runs while every owner is still held; the emptied mapping is published before the first GIL-releasing free; every slot is attempted and the first failure is retained; failed entries are republished; owners are released as the operation's last step, before the first failure is restored. A hidden Arrow owner's finalizer (PyForeignBuffer::base_, PyBuffer::py_buf_) therefore runs inside the operation but after all native work, sees a closed cache, and cannot replace the error. Ordinary Arrow-backed pandas owners (float64/int64[pyarrow] columns, string[pyarrow] index) stay supported; no narrowed draft, no refusal, no Python fallback, no deferred destruction outside the operation.
